summary: This table presents an overview of client metrics for the quarters ending June 30, 2024, March 31, 2024, and June 30, 2023. It includes the number of active clients, clients added during the period, and the count of million-dollar clients across various thresholds (1 million, 10 million, 50 million, and 100 million dollars). Additionally, it details client contributions to revenues, highlighting the percentage contributions from the top 5, top 10, and top 25 clients, as well as the Days Sales Outstanding metric. Notably, the number of active clients decreased slightly from March 2024 to June 2024, while the percentage contributions from the top clients show a slight increase over the year.
